Content Marketing Budgets in 2026

Content marketing budgets grew 7% this year according to a survey of 412 marketing leaders published by the Content Marketing Institute. The median B2B team now spends $310,000 per year on content production and distribution, up from $290,000 in 2025.

The biggest increase was in video, where 46% of respondents raised spending. Paid distribution budgets were flat. Teams with a documented strategy were 2.1 times more likely to report budget growth than those without one.
